records.subject: spec-guard-codex
evidence: command:edit the `ref` line of [marketplaces.spec-guard-marketplace] in ~/.codex/config.toml from v0.48.0 to v0.49.0
result:the upgrade exited 0 and `codex plugin list --json` reports spec-guard 0.49.0, installed and enabled

records.subject: spec-guard-codex-cli-smoke
evidence: result:the smoke exited 0 and its machine session record contained a valid Spec Guard phase injection

records.subject: spec-guard-codex-session-context
evidence: command:codex exec --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust --skip-git-repo-check 'reply with ok' in a temporary activated project, with a temporary project hook that recorded only the UserPromptSubmit input's keys and whether transcript_path exists (removed afterwards)

result:the input carried cwd, hook_event_name, model, permission_mode, prompt, session_id, transcript_path and turn_id; transcript_path was a non-empty string naming an existing rollout file under ~/.codex/sessions/

result:the installed copy read 21797 tokens and a 258400-token window, equal to the rollout's last token_count record read by hand, so Codex sessions feed the context hint and its 50% / 80% thresholds
result:the line itself was not observed on a real Codex session at or above 129200 / 206720 tokens; that part rests on the regression tests
